terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.intro: Last updated: June 2026. By using Masaarat you agree to these terms as they stand today. They may change as the platform evolves.
terms.section.acceptance.title: Acceptance of terms
terms.section.acceptance.body: Masaarat (masaarat.ai) is an educational platform. Creating an account or using the content means you agree to these terms and to the
terms.section.acceptableUse.title: Acceptable use
terms.section.acceptableUse.body: Use the platform for personal or legitimate professional learning. You may not misuse the service, attempt to breach systems, scrape content without permission, or share your account beyond what your plan allows.
terms.section.abuse.title: Prohibited abuse
terms.section.abuse.body: Do not use the platform or the AI assistant to produce illegal, misleading, abusive, or rights-infringing content. We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate this.
terms.section.educationalDisclaimer.body: Content and the smart assistant provide general educational guidance—not professional advice (legal, financial, medical, or otherwise). You are responsible for your decisions and for verifying information before applying it in your work or projects.
terms.section.accountResponsibility.body: You are responsible for keeping your login credentials confidential and for all activity on your account. Tell us immediately if you suspect unauthorized access.
terms.section.subscription.title: Subscription and payment
terms.section.subscription.body: Some paths or features may be paid or pending activation («coming soon»). When paid plans launch, pricing and renewal or cancellation terms will be shown clearly before payment. During early access, prices or available features may change without long advance notice.
terms.section.platformRights.title: Platform rights
terms.section.platformRights.body: Lesson content, brand assets, software, and educational materials on Masaarat are owned by or licensed to the platform. You may not copy, republish, or sell them without written permission, except for personal use within your account.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Last updated: June 2026. The platform is in early access — this policy may change as the product evolves. We recommend reviewing it periodically.
privacy.section.whoWeAre.title: Who we are
privacy.section.whoWeAre.body: Masaarat (masaarat.ai) is an educational platform for learning artificial intelligence by doing. We respect your privacy and explain here how we handle your data during this early stage.
privacy.section.accountData.title: Account data
privacy.section.accountData.body: When you sign up we collect basic information such as your email, password (encrypted), and profile details you choose to provide. We use this to run your account, track lesson progress, and manage your subscription when it is active.
privacy.section.analytics.title: Analytics and platform use
privacy.section.analytics.body: We record technical activity and platform usage — such as lessons you open, session duration, and technical errors — to improve the experience and fix issues. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.
privacy.section.aiUse.title: Use of artificial intelligence
privacy.section.aiUse.body: The platform assistant and AI-related features process your text and questions to provide educational guidance. Your conversations are not used for advertising. We may store limited context to improve response quality within your account. Do not enter sensitive information (passwords, financial data, trade secrets) in chats.
privacy.section.cookies.title: Cookies and essential tracking
privacy.section.cookies.body: We use cookies and local storage needed for sign-in, saving your preferences, and measuring platform performance in aggregate. You can configure your browser to reject some cookies, but some features may not work fully.
privacy.section.contact.title: Contact and support
privacy.section.contact.body: For any privacy or data questions, email us at
privacy.section.accountDeletion.title: Account deletion and data requests
privacy.section.accountDeletion.bodyBefo: You can request account deletion or export/deletion of your personal data by email above or from your
privacy.section.accountDeletion.bodyAfte: page when the deletion tool is available. We process requests as soon as possible during early access.
